subject: Request: convert SDR headcount to SE + comp-band exception (West)
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: TwiceHires Recruiting <recruiter@twicehires.co>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T09:21:00-08:00
Subject: Request: convert SDR headcount to SE + comp-band exception (West)

Team —

Quick summary: Id like approval to convert two open SDR headcount (Q4 unfilled roles in West region) into two Solutions Engineer (SE) headcount to support a high-propensity accounts push with Acme Corp and a handful of other mid-market deals. Were seeing a persistent gap on pre-sales coverage that is blocking 3 live POCs. Converting existing SDR slots is the fastest path to ramp coverage without increasing net headcount this quarter.

Why this makes sense now:
- Forecasted pipeline: $2.6M influenced in next 90 days tied to accounts that require dedicated SE support.
- Time-to-impact: an internal conversion + expedited comp exception allows candidate start in mid-Dec vs 8+ weeks for new req.
- Hiring capacity: TwiceHires can supply two experienced SE candidates with prior platform integration experience (attached resumes upon request).

Ask:
1) Approve converting 2x SDR headcount (requisition IDs: REQ-1342, REQ-1343) into 2x SE headcount for West region.
2) Approve temporary comp-band exception for the two converted roles (see proposed bands in attached updated-offer-bands-v2.xlsx): base up to $150k + up to $40k variable + one-time sign-on up to $10k for urgent offers. This is a one-time exception for conversions only.
3) Finance confirmation on budget-neutral treatment or one-time hiring credit to offset Q4 impact.

Attachments: hc-plan-q4.xlsx, updated-offer-bands-v2.xlsx
Related links: Greenhouse reqs and HC workbook in Drive.

Timeline: decision by end of Tuesday 11/9 to hit Dec 13 target start.

If youd like, I can pull a short deck showing pipeline lift and POC list before we finalize.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-07T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: convert SDR headcount to SE + comp-band exception (West)

Diego —

Thanks for the clear ask. Im supportive in principle of converting SDR slots to SEs if its the fastest way to preserve deals. Two quick requests before I sign off:
1) Add expected revenue net lift by quarter (Q4/Q1) per candidate (even a range is fine).
2) Confirm whether these SDRs are currently counted against quota-bearing headcount; if so, how well backfill the SDR capacity or reassign outreach.

If Finance gives a path for a one-time hiring credit, Im comfortable approving the comp-band exception for conversions only.

-M

Team —

Attached is the cost delta worksheet with line items and offset suggestions (attached: cost-impact-06112026.pdf). Top-level: net FY26 exposure is $18k if we grant the full sign-on. Offsets proposed: move two pending contractor dollars ($25k) into Q4 (marketing holdback) + freeze one planned SDR refill in APAC (saves $22k). Overall we come out slightly positive.

Pipeline lift estimates (conservative): $900k ACV influence this quarter from the two SEs (probability-weighted). Ive annotated the HC workbook with expected POC owners and ramp schedule. If Finance signs off, TwiceHires can present two candidates for quick offers next week.

Next steps I recommend:
- Marcus: confirm approval for a $18k net FY26 exposure and authorize comp-band exception.
- Neha/PeopleOps: prepare temporary reclassification and two Greenhouse conversions (REQ-1342/1343) so recruiters can submit offers.
- Marissa/Karthik: final confirmation on role profiles and interview panels.

Thanks — Diego
